name: 4th of July — Willow Cascade
description: Classic willow-style fireworks with long, drooping golden and silver trails that hang in the night sky like luminous weeping branches. Fewer shells but each one paints a slow-falling curtain of sparks with gentle wind drift. Strong temporal persistence creates a cinematic long-exposure feel. Bass deepens the droop, treble adds silver micro-sparkle along the trails. Mouse launches a personal willow shell at the cursor.
